mapper.select: SELECT SETTLEMENT_YM AS settlementYm, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS errorCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(PENDING_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalPendingAmount FROM TB_MERCHANT_SETTLEMENT WHERE SETTLEMENT_YM = #{settlementYm} GROUP BY SETTLEMENT_YM
